verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents webhooks that notify consumers when API resources are created or updated, plus dashboard notification subscriptions. These are event notifications and developer building blocks a user could wire up externally. They are not a product-native way to define rules that automatically trigger actions. Payout schedules and automated reports are recurring or scheduled features, not event-triggered rules, so they do not count either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
